item.text: The statement says: **if someone is a member of the club, then they own a bicycle**. It does not say that bicycle ownership is limited to club members. People outside the club may also own bicycles, so owning a bicycle does not prove membership. In logical terms, the sign gives a one-way implication—club member → bicycle owner—not the reverse implication—bicycle owner → club member. Thus, the two groups can overlap without being identical.
